source_cohort: r4 GUI product and instrumented66 artifacts; CLI-only help edit and its separate rebuilt/tested receipt are outside this GUI cohort.
provenance: UI actions, Save/download/Open and playback were observed by root. Stills corroborate visible state; actions are not inferred from the stills. Exact file/report identities and byte hashes are independently inspectable.
limits: Byte sizes are file inventory, not transfer, startup or performance measurements. CPU reports are not GPU readback or complete asset-store-disposal evidence. Full visual quality remains unaccepted.
